questions.question: Which entity was awarded a ₹30 crore contract by the DRDO for the development of an advanced Electronic Warfare (EW) system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS).**__

__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Contract:** The project involves the design, development, and supply of a sophisticated **Electronic Warfare (EW)** system tailored for the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• **Strategic Importance:** This system is designed to detect, intercept, and jam enemy communications and radar signals, enhancing the **electronic defense capabilities** of the country.
 
• **Atmanirbhar Bharat:** The award highlights the increasing role of private-sector defense firms and MSMEs in India’s mission to achieve self-reliance in high-end defense technology.
 
• **The Entity:** **Unistring Tech Solutions (UTS)** is a Hyderabad-based firm specializing in RF (Radio Frequency) and high-speed digital subsystems.
 
• **Timeline:** The development is expected to be completed within a specified timeframe to meet the immediate operational requirements of the defense forces.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Electronic Warfare (EW)__

 __
 
• EW involves the use of the electromagnetic spectrum to sense, protect, and communicate, while simultaneously denying the enemy the ability to use the same.
 
 
 
• DRDO Industry Interface__
 
 
• DRDO has been actively partnering with Indian industries through the **Development-cum-Production Partner (DcPP)** model to accelerate the deployment of indigenous military hardware.

questions.question: Who among the following secured the Mixed Doubles Championship at Wimbledon 2025?

• The duo showcased exceptional coordination and skill throughout the tournament, defeating formidable opponents in every round.
 
• Their victory in the final match was a significant achievement, as they secured their first Grand Slam title as a pair in mixed doubles.
 
• Katerina Siniaková is widely recognized as one of the top doubles players in the world, having previously won multiple women's doubles Grand Slam titles.
 
• Their win at Wimbledon 2025 is celebrated as one of the highlights of the tournament, cementing their place in tennis history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Joe Salisbury is a British professional tennis player known for his success in men's doubles, including Grand Slam wins.
 
• Harriet Dart, another British player, has primarily competed in singles and doubles events but has not secured a major mixed doubles title.
 
 
 
• **Jamie Murray and Bethanie Mattek-Sands**
 
 
• Jamie Murray, a skilled doubles player from Great Britain, has achieved multiple mixed doubles Grand Slam victories in the past.
 
• Bethanie Mattek-Sands, an American player, is known for her versatility and success in both women's and mixed doubles.
 
• This duo has previously participated in Grand Slam mixed doubles events but did not win Wimbledon 2025.

• Desirae Krawczyk, an American player, has been successful in mixed doubles, including multiple Grand Slam victories.
 
• Though both players have a strong track record in mixed doubles, they were not the Wimbledon 2025 champions.
 
 
 
• **Mixed Doubles Tennis**
 
 
• Mixed doubles is a format in tennis where teams are composed of one male and one female player.
 
• This format is played at all four Grand Slam tournaments, offering a unique dynamic and strategy compared to men's and women's doubles.
 
• Wimbledon, held annually in London, is one of the most prestigious tennis tournaments globally, famous for its grass courts and rich history.

questions.question: What is the full form of the 'SAHI' initiative launched by the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare?

options.text: System for Artificial Health Intelligence in India
Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On February 17, 2026, Union Health Minister Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda launched the SAHI initiative during the India AI Impact Summit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Full Form:** **SAHI** stands for **Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India**.
 
• **Purpose:** It serves as a **governance framework, policy compass, and national roadmap** to ensure that AI adoption in healthcare is ethical, transparent, and people-centric.
 
• **Governance:** It provides a common framework for the Union and State Governments, as well as private partners, to guide AI evaluation and integration.
 
• **Digital Foundation:** The initiative is built upon the digital public infrastructure established by the **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)** and the **National Health Policy, 2017**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **BODH:** Along with SAHI, the **Benchmarking Open Data Platform for Health AI (BODH)** was launched.
 
• **Development:** BODH was developed by **IIT Kanpur** in collaboration with the National Health Authority to test and validate AI solutions before large-scale deployment.
 
• **Global Recognition:** The World Health Organization (WHO) commended India as one of the first countries to adopt a national AI strategy for health.

questions.question: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation rose to a 9-month high of what percent in January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1.81%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **According to provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on February 16, 2026, India's wholesale inflation rose to 1.81% in January 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Surge:** The WPI inflation rate of **1.81%** is a significant jump from the **0.83%** recorded in December 2025. This represents the highest level of wholesale inflation in roughly nine to ten months.
 
• **Primary Drivers:** The increase was primarily driven by a rise in the prices of **manufactured products** (which carry the highest weight in the WPI basket at 64.23%) and **primary articles**, including food.
 
• **Food Inflation:** The WPI Food Index saw a turnaround, rising to **1.41%** in January. Notably, vegetable prices returned to inflationary territory with a **6.78%** increase, compared to a contraction in the previous month.
 
• **Sector Performance:**
 
 
• **Manufactured Products:** Inflation rose to **2.86%** (from 1.82% in Dec), led by basic metals and textiles.
 
• **Primary Articles:** Inflation stood at **2.21%**.
 
• **Fuel & Power:** This segment remained in deflation at **-4.01%**, though the pace of decline varied for electricity and mineral oils.
 
 
 
• **Economic Context:** While WPI reflects price changes at the factory gate, the RBI primarily monitors **Retail Inflation (CPI)**, which stood at **2.75%** for the same period. Low WPI generally suggests that input costs for businesses remain relatively stable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **About WPI (Wholesale Price Index)__**

 
• **Base Year:** 2011-12.
 
• **Released By:** Office of the Economic Adviser, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
 
• **Components:** Manufactured Products (64.23%), Primary Articles (22.62%), and Fuel & Power (13.15%).

questions.question: The 17th BRICS Summit, which discussed various issues on the BRICS agenda, was held on 6-7 July 2025 at which of the following places?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rio de Janeiro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **17th BRICS Summit** was held on **6-7 July 2025** in **Rio de Janeiro, Brazil**.
 
• **BRICS** is an acronym for an association of five major emerging economies: **Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa**.
 
• The BRICS Summit is an annual diplomatic meeting aimed at discussing issues of **economic cooperation, global governance, and sustainable development**.
 
• The choice of **Rio de Janeiro** as the location signifies Brazil’s active role in promoting **South-South cooperation**.
 
• Rio de Janeiro is one of the most prominent cities in Brazil and is known for its **historic, cultural, and economic significance**.
 
• The summit discussed key topics such as **trade, investment, climate change, and technological advancements**.
 
• It also focused on strengthening the **New Development Bank (NDB)**, a multilateral financial institution established by BRICS nations.
 
• Rio de Janeiro has previously hosted major international events like the **2016 Summer Olympics** and the **1992 Earth Summit**, making it a suitable venue for such a significant global meeting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kazan**__

 __
 
• **Kazan** is a city in **Russia** and is known for its rich cultural heritage and historical significance.
 
• It is a major center of **sports and education** in Russia and has hosted events like the **2018 FIFA World Cup**.
 
• Kazan is not related to the **17th BRICS Summit**, as the summit was not held there in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Johannesburg**__
 __
 
• **Johannesburg** is one of the largest cities in **South Africa** and a hub for business and finance.
 
• It has hosted previous BRICS Summits, such as the **10th BRICS Summit in 2018**.
 
• However, it was not the venue for the **17th BRICS Summit in 2025**.
 
 
 
• **Fortaleza**__
 
 
• **Fortaleza** is a city in **Brazil** and was the venue for the **6th BRICS Summit in 2014**.
 
• It is an important city in the northeastern region of Brazil, known for its **beautiful beaches and tourism**.
 
• Despite its prior association with BRICS, Fortaleza was not the host city for the **17th BRICS Summit** in 2025.

questions.question: The term "Operation Stripes," which made headlines in February 2026, refers to which wildlife conservation initiative?

options.text: A census of leopards in the Western Ghats.
The rescue and release of the tiger ‘Explorer’ in Andhra Pradesh.
A program to restore elephant corridors in Odisha.
A campaign against the illegal trade of tiger skins.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The rescue and release of the tiger ‘Explorer’ in Andhra Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Stripes:** This was a specialized operation by the Andhra Pradesh Forest Department to capture, monitor, and relocate an adult male tiger nicknamed **'Explorer'**.
 
• **The Journey:** The tiger gained fame for its incredible 650 km migration from **Maharashtra** through Telangana before being tranquilized in the Kakinada district of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **Successful Release:** On February 14, 2026, the tiger was successfully released into the core area of **Papikonda National Park (PNP)**.
 
• **First-time Tech:** This operation marked the first time the state used **satellite collaring** and real-time GPS tracking to monitor a tiger's adaptation to its new habitat.
 
• **Prey Management:** As part of the operation, authorities also initiated plans to increase the herbivore (prey) population in the park to support the big cat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Note__**

 
• While **M-STrIPES** is a general software tool for tiger monitoring used across India, **"Operation Stripes"** was the specific name given to this 2026 rescue mission in Andhra Pradesh.

questions.question: In 2025, what was the theme of the International Day of Light?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Light, Innovation, Society**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The International Day of Light is celebrated annually on **May 16th** to recognize the role light plays in science, culture, art, education, and sustainable development.
 
• The theme for 2025, **"Light, Innovation, Society,"** highlights the importance of light-based technologies in addressing global challenges and improving quality of life.
 
• This theme underscores the role of light in fostering technological advancements, innovation, and its significance in creating a more inclusive and sustainable society.
 
• The International Day of Light is a UNESCO initiative that commemorates the first successful operation of the laser by **Theodore Maiman on May 16, 1960**.
 
• The day brings together scientists, policymakers, and the general public to promote awareness about how light-based innovations can address pressing issues like energy efficiency, healthcare, education, and agriculture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lighting Cities**

 
 
• This concept focuses on the role of urban lighting in creating sustainable, safe, and vibrant cities.
 
• Lighting plays a critical role in urban infrastructure, supporting activities such as nighttime navigation, public safety, and energy efficiency.
 
• While relevant, this option does not align with the broader focus of the International Day of Light’s 2025 theme.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable World**
 
 
• The idea of a "Sustainable World" emphasizes achieving environmental, social, and economic sustainability.
 
• Although light technologies contribute to sustainability, the 2025 theme specifically highlights the societal and innovation-driven aspects of light.
 
 
 
• **Energy Saving**
 
 
• This pertains to reducing energy consumption through efficient technologies, such as LED lighting and renewable energy solutions.
 
• While energy saving is a critical application of light-based technologies, it is not the central focus of the 2025 theme.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme of International Day of Light**
 
 
• The International Day of Light emphasizes the role of light in science, education, and sustainable development.
 
• The day aims to inspire global collaboration and innovation in areas such as photonics, healthcare, and clean energy solutions.
 
• It also highlights how light-based technologies can help address global issues, including climate change, poverty, and access to education.

questions.question: The Chintan Shivir held in Udaipur in January 2025 was organised by the _____.

options.text: Ministry of Women and Child Development

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Women and Child Development**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Chintan Shivir held in Udaipur in January 2025 was organized by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development** to address critical issues pertaining to women empowerment and child welfare.
 
• Chintan Shivir is an initiative aimed at fostering collaboration among policymakers, stakeholders, and grassroots organizations to improve the implementation of schemes and policies.
 
• The Ministry of Women and Child Development focuses on creating an inclusive society by addressing issues like gender equality, child protection, nutrition, and the rights of women and children.
 
• Key discussions in such events include policy reforms, new program launches, and addressing bottlenecks in existing schemes.
 
• The Ministry has spearheaded numerous national schemes such as **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Poshan Abhiyaan, and Mission Shakti**, which aim to improve the socio-economic status of women and children in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Education**

 
 
• The Ministry of Education is primarily responsible for developing and implementing educational policies and initiatives in India.
 
• It oversees various programs such as **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan, Mid-Day Meal Scheme, and PM eVIDYA** to ensure inclusive and equitable education for all.
 
• Key focus areas include improving literacy rates, enhancing digital education, and promoting skill development among youth.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Culture**
 
 
• The Ministry of Culture is tasked with preserving, promoting, and fostering the cultural heritage of India.
 
• It manages institutions like museums, archives, and libraries and organizes various cultural festivals and events.
 
• Prominent schemes include **Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat, Kala Sanskriti Vikas Yojana, and National Mission on Cultural Mapping**.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs**
 
 
• The Ministry of Tribal Affairs focuses on the socio-economic development of tribal communities in India.
 
• Key initiatives include **Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana, Eklavya Model Residential Schools, and Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India (TRIFED)**.
 
• It works to ensure better access to education, healthcare, and livelihood opportunities for tribal populations.
 
 
 
• **Overview of Chintan Shivir**
 
 
• Chintan Shivir is a strategic brainstorming session held by various ministries or organizations to analyze progress, identify challenges, and formulate plans for future initiatives.
 
• These events often serve as platforms for knowledge sharing, collaboration, and innovation in policy implementation.
